description: instagram: Story Highlights. GET /v1/instagram/user/highlights. List the story highlights a signed-out visitor sees on a profile: id, title, cropped cover URL and owner. Instagram shows signed-out visitors only some of an account's highlights. cover_media.thumbnail_src is always null; use cover_media_cropped_thumbnail.url. Pass the id to /v1/instagram/user/highlight/detail for the stories. Requires handle: a lookup by user_id needs a login and returns 400. Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.

handle.description: The Instagram username, with or without @ (required)

user_id.description: Not supported: a lookup by user_id needs a login. Pass handle; user_id alone returns 400.

name: instagram_user_highlights
